en:
<CLT=cltMIND>If this computer weren't here...
Miu never would have planned a murder.

<CLT=cltMIND>I know I shouldn't think like that,
but I can't help it...

<CLT=cltMIND>This is where we found the Flashback Light
that gave us that memory, but...

<CLT=cltMIND>I can't help but feel like...there's more
to that memory than it seems.
